raw.query: SELECT c.window_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.run_id) AS folds, BOOL_AND(c.is_current) AS all_current, BOOL_AND(d.superseded_by IS NULL) AS none_superseded, MIN(c.numerator_worker_seconds) AS numerator_worker_seconds_min, MAX(c.numerator_worker_seconds) AS numerator_worker_seconds_max, MIN(c.denominator_worker_seconds) AS denominator_worker_seconds, MIN(c.denominator_workers) AS denominator_workers, MIN(c.cost_ratio) AS cost_ratio_min, MAX(c.cost_ratio) AS cost_ratio_max, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.cost_ratio < 1) AS rows_below_static, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.cost_ratio >= 1) AS rows_at_or_above_static, BOOL_OR(c.denominator_window_mismatch) AS denominator_window_mismatch, MIN(c.denominator_basis) AS denominator_basis FROM provenance.v_cost_ratio c JOIN provenance.v_dim d ON d.run_id = c.run_id AND d.is_current = true WHERE c.is_current = true AND c.experiment = 'g6' AND c.pool = 'encoder' AND c.policy = 'forecast' AND c.denominator_kind = 'deployable_static_c8' GROUP BY c.window_name ORDER BY c.window_name
